summary: Senior Java engineer with 10 years on Spring-based services in banking. Tech lead for the core payments engine at BankCore — 1.4M txns/day, six-nines availability across 3 data centers.

Built REST APIs on Spring MVC backed by Oracle DB. Migrated 3 batch jobs from Quartz to Spring Batch.

certifications: Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE Programmer
